tasks.label: Check configured credentials
args: process.loadEnvFile(); console.log(JSON.stringify({ geminiConfigured: Boolean(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY), tiktokConfigured: Boolean(process.env.TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN) }));

tasks.label: Restart Content Agent on port 3000
args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($listener) { $listener.OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force } }; node server.js
